verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers scripting syntax, editor collaboration, physics components, and the MCP server for AI-assisted project editing, but contains no documentation of an explicit event/rule system where users can define triggers that automatically fire actions (e.g., event listeners, condition-action bindings) for automation purposes. Missing for 10: documentation of an event-trigger/rule engine, examples of defining conditional automation, and evidence tying this to AI-native workflows.
